Get Free Consultation Scholarships Scholarships for AI and Machine Learning | 2026 UPDATED List July 13, 2025 Artificial intelligence is rapidly taking position in all industries. Many traditional positions are handed to AI-based tools, leaving humans unemployed! If you want to make a future in your industry, you should move beside the AI advancements. There are many AI and machine learning programs worldwide, yet financial matters are hurdles to studying abroad. This Abroadin guide lists 32 scholarships for AI programs and opportunities to help you find the most-suited one more easily. Table of Contents Responsive Banner Global Scholarships for AI If you have not decided about the destination yet, let’s consider some scholarships for all European countries, the US, and even Asia. The following scholarships are awarded in different regions and industries: 1. Erasmus Mundus AI Scholarships (Europe) The Erasmus Mundus AI Scholarships are great opportunities for international students pursuing advanced studies in artificial intelligence. They are fully funded scholarships and cover tuition, travel expenses, and a monthly stipend. They allow recipients to study at two or more prestigious European universities. These programs provide specialized training in cutting-edge fields: AI4Gov (AI in government and policy), BDMA (Big Data), and EMAI (AI-focused Master’s) Applicants must apply between October and January every year through program-specific websites. Apply for the Erasmus Mundus AI scholarships here! 2. DAAD Scholarships for AI (Germany) The DAAD Scholarships pay full or partial funding, a monthly stipend (from €850 to over €1,200), travel, and health costs. Top German universities, such as TU Munich and RWTH Aachen, offer programs in AI, Machine Learning, and Data Engineering. While eligibility requires a bachelor’s degree, some courses prefer applicants with prior work or research experience. Applying through DAAD-listed AI research programs can improve your chances of securing this prestigious opportunity. Apply for DAAD scholarships here! 3. Chevening Scholarships with AI Focus (UK) The Chevening Scholarships are great opportunities for international students to study artificial intelligence at world-class institutions like the University of Oxford, Cambridge, or UCL. This award provides full tuition coverage, a monthly living allowance, travel expenses, and visa support. It allows scholars to focus on their studies in fields such as AI, Data Science, Machine Learning, and Robotics. Eligibility requires applicants from over 160 countries to demonstrate at least two years of professional or research experience and strong leadership potential. If you like to study abroad and also meet the criteria, this scholarship could be your pathway to an advanced AI education in the UK. Looking for free advice? Contact us on WhatsApp for instant support! Message Us Apply for Chevening scholarships here! 4. Fulbright Foreign Student Program (US) The Fulbright Scholarship presents an exceptional opportunity for international students seeking advanced studies in artificial intelligence at American institutions like MIT and Stanford. This award provides full financial support, including tuition, airfare, living expenses, and health insurance for Master’s or PhD programs in AI, Computer Science (AI specialization), Machine Learning, Robotics, and Data Science. Eligibility is restricted to citizens of participating countries with strong academic credentials and leadership potential. A unique requirement is the commitment to return to one’s home country after completing studies. Successful applicants often stand out by clearly articulating how their AI expertise will help solve critical challenges in their home nation. Apply for the Fulbright Foreign Student Program here! 5. MEXT Scholarships for AI (Japan) The MEXT Scholarship in Japan allows international students to study AI-related programs such as Artificial Intelligence, Robotics, and Machine Learning-focused Computer Science. It covers full tuition, a generous monthly stipend of about ¥143,000, round-trip airfare, and no application fees. Applicants must pass academic or language screenings, depending on their level—undergraduate, Master’s, or PhD. Apply for the MEXT scholarship here! US-Focused AI Scholarships There are many opportunities in AI and machine learning fields for those who want to continue their studies in the US. The following are the most popular US AI scholarships for international students. 6. Richard E. Merwin Scholarship (IEEE Computer Society) IEEE Computer Society offers the Richard E. Merwin Scholarship to support student volunteers in computing-related fields. It awards up to $1,000 per recipient from a total annual fund of $40,000. Applicants must be active IEEE student members, and have excellent grades. A unique aspect of this scholarship is that recipients are appointed as Student Ambassadors. It allows them to build leadership skills and connect more deeply within the IEEE community. Apply for the Richard E. Merwin scholarship here! 7. Lockheed Martin Scholarships for AI This scholarship financially supports undergrads studying computer science or engineering, especially those aiming for careers in AI or related tech fields. International students need at least a 2.5 GPA to apply, which makes it pretty accessible for most applicants. What really stands out is its focus on promoting innovation in areas such as aerospace, defense, and Artificial Intelligence. Apply for the Lockheed Martin scholarship here! 8. Northrop Grumman Scholarship These scholarships for AI helps international students financially to study computer science, math, physics, or engineering. It is open to American citizens enrolled in approved programs. Its main goal is to develop skilled talent for roles tied to national security and tech innovation. Northrop Grumman scholarship is not just about easing tuition costs—it’s about backing students who are ready to tackle the country’s most significant technological challenges. Apply for the Northrop Grumman scholarship here! 9. Betty Stevens Frecknall Scholarship Eligible candidates for the Betty Stevens Frecknall scholarship must maintain a minimum 3.0 GPA and demonstrate academic excellence and discipline commitment. This scholarship encourages recipients to push boundaries in AI innovation by recognizing outstanding achievements. It is for passionate learners and provides a unique opportunity to excel in a rapidly growing field of study. Apply for the Betty Stevens Frecknall Scholarship here! 10. Upsilon Pi Epsilon Scholarships for AI The Upsilon Pi Epsilon Scholarship brings international students a lifeline to a brighter future in AI-related fields of study. What makes it stand out is that it highlights people making fundamental contributions to the tech and engineering communities, not just book smarts. With this scholarship, driven students get a chance to keep innovating, tackle big ideas in AI, and shape the direction of technology with grit and vision. Apply for the Upsilon Pi Epsilon scholarship here! If you want to know more about How to Apply for Scholarships in the US? read this article: How to Apply for Scholarships in the US? Looking for free advice? Contact us on WhatsApp for instant support! Message Us Diversity-Focused Scholarships for AI Some scholarships are for specific groups. In this section, we share four financial aids for women and certain people in artificial intelligence. 11. Society of Women Engineers (SWE) Scholarships The Society of Women Engineers (SWE) offers many scholarships to support women pursuing engineering degrees, including those focused on artificial intelligence. In 2023 alone, they awarded over $1.5 million through 330+ scholarships. Women enrolled in ABET-accredited programs can apply with just one application to be considered for all qualifying awards. This program doesn’t just ease financial burdens—it actively empowers women entering tech fields where they’ve historically been underrepresented. It’s a game-changer for many aspiring female engineers exploring AI and beyond. Apply for the SWE scholarship here! 12. Paul and Ellen Ruckes Scholarships for AI The Paul and Ellen Ruckes Scholarship offers meaningful financial assistance to students who are legally blind and passionate about technology. This scholarship is for full-time students in fields like computer science, engineering, or physical sciences—including those studying AI. It’s not just about funding; it’s about recognizing the potential of individuals who often face added barriers in STEM. This program pushes for greater inclusion in tech and supports visually impaired scholars and other needy applicants. Apply for the Paul and Ellen Ruckes scholarship here! 13. Intel AI for Youth Scholarship The Intel AI for Youth Scholarship offers close to $2 million every year to help international students in STEM, especially those studying AI. This program aims at applicants who’ve been underrepresented for too long, including African American, Latinx, Native American students, women, and veterans. If you’re in one of those groups and studying AI-related stuff, this could open doors to a great future, both professionally and personally. Apply for the Intel AI for Youth scholarship here! 14. AnitaB.org Systers Pass It On Awards The AnitaB.org Systers Pass It On Awards aren’t your typical scholarship—they have the heart to support women worldwide. Whether you’re studying AI, coding your first app, or launching a tech initiative, if you’re a woman in tech anywhere in the world, you’re in the running. This award fuels growth and community in a field where women are still outnumbered. It’s mentorship meets momentum, with real impact. Apply for the AnitaB.org Systers Pass It On Award here! Industry and Research AI Programs Some companies and organizations also award scholarships for AI and machine learning programs. If you want to get financial aid from a specific company in AI business, check the following ones. 15. DeepMind Scholarships for AI The DeepMind Scholarship provides full tuition coverage, a living allowance, and grants for travel and equipment. It is available for students pursuing studies in Artificial Intelligence, Machine Learning, or Computer Vision at top universities like Oxford, UCL, Cambridge, NYU, and McGill. The scholarship is for students from underrepresented groups in technology, with specific eligibility criteria set by each university. A key part of the program is the opportunity for mentorship and networking with DeepMind researchers, which helps students build skills and connections in AI. Apply for DeepMind Scholarship here! 16. OpenAI Residency Program The OpenAI Residency Program is for researchers and engineers who are new to AI and are looking for a way to enter the field. It is for those coming from other areas—software engineering, neuroscience, physics, and more—who want to shift into AI research. Participants work closely with OpenAI teams, gaining real project experience. The program also acts as a stepping stone to full-time roles at OpenAI. Apply for the OpenAI Residency Program here! 17. Microsoft Research PhD Fellowship The Microsoft Research PhD Fellowship is for supporting exceptional PhD students working in AI, machine learning, and related fields. The fellowship includes funding for tuition and living expenses, along with opportunities for mentorship from Microsoft researchers. Applicants must be enrolled in a PhD program and demonstrate a strong potential to contribute to the field through innovative research. A key feature of the fellowship is its alignment with Microsoft Research’s long-term goals. Some benefits include: Tuit
